titleEn: Set who pays Meta for a number

operatorReason.text: a merchant with unknown funding cannot send and cannot fix it themselves; could be self-service for own numbers (card on Meta is the default) with an operator reason only for platform_line

ar: مين بيعمل تحديد مين بيدفع لميتا للرقم؟
ليه مش لاقي تحديد مين بيدفع لميتا للرقم عندي؟

en: Why can I not do this myself: Set who pays Meta for a number?

steps: Super admin only; every write re-checks the session (fails closed) and is audited with actor and reason
edgeCases: Assistant refuses and offers the merchant-facing alternative or a handoff to Ebda
gaps: Self-service gap: a merchant with unknown funding cannot send and cannot fix it themselves; could be self-service for own numbers (card on Meta is the default) with an operator reason only for platform_line
operator replaces: wallet.funding (merchant cannot choose card vs wallet or fix unknown funding)
